{"id":"project-LICHEN-9j70.30","title":"RX_TIMEOUT_MS of 5000ms may starve other work","description":"lora_l2.c:42: #define RX_TIMEOUT_MS 5000

The RX thread blocks in lora_recv for up to 5 seconds per iteration. During this time, the running flag is not checked (it's only checked at loop top).

What goes wrong: lichen_lora_l2_stop() sets running=0 and joins the thread. If the thread is blocked in lora_recv, stop waits up to 5.1 seconds (100ms + 5000ms join timeouts).

This is documented and handled (abort after timeout), but 5 seconds is long for a stop operation. A user calling disable/enable in quick succession may see unexpected delays.

Fix: Consider shorter RX timeout (500-1000ms) with the understanding that more loop iterations means more running-flag checks. Or expose via Kconfig. The current 5s is reasonable for battery savings but poor for responsiveness.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-06-27T18:20:08.804739Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-06-27T18:26:31.735842Z","closed_at":"2026-06-27T18:26:31.735842Z","close_reason":"Fixed: Reduced RX_TIMEOUT_MS from 5000ms to 1000ms (default) via new CONFIG_LICHEN_LORA_L2_RX_TIMEOUT_MS Kconfig option. Stop latency reduced from 5.1s to 1.1s worst case. Users can adjust via Kconfig (100-10000ms range).","labels":["maintainer-burden","owner-reserved","review","risk","zephyr"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-9j70.30","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-9j70","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-06-27T18:20:08.805824Z"}]}

new_value: Already fixed in current HEAD by a prior review-fix wave; verified, no further change needed. The bead's 'or expose via Kconfig' option was implemented: lora_l2.c:153 now uses #define RX_TIMEOUT_MS CONFIG_LICHEN_LORA_L2_RX_TIMEOUT_MS, and firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/Kconfig:122-137 adds config LICHEN_LORA_L2_RX_TIMEOUT_MS with default 1000 (inside the bead's recommended 500-1000ms band, down from the reviewed hard-coded 5000), range 100-10000, and help text documenting the responsiveness/power trade-off. Stop-latency interaction (100ms quick join + timeout budget) documented in lichen_lora_l2_stop().
